# data.docker_logs

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads a container's logs (`GET /containers/{id}/logs`) as a list of lines. Output of containers without a TTY is demultiplexed, so lines carry no stream headers; stdout and stderr are interleaved in the order the daemon returns them. The read does not follow the log, and keeps at most 16 MiB.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `container` | `string` | required |  |  | Container name or ID. |
| `details` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Add the extra attributes the log driver records (for example labels) to each line. Default `false`. |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Container ID. |
| `logs_list_string` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Log lines without their trailing newline. |
| `show_stderr` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include standard error. Default `true`. |
| `show_stdout` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include standard output. Default `true`. |
| `since` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines after this time: RFC 3339 timestamp, Unix timestamp, or a duration relative to now such as `10m`. |
| `tail` | `string` | optional |  |  | Number of lines to read from the end of the log, or `all`. Default `all`. |
| `timestamps` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Prefix every line with its RFC 3339 timestamp. Default `false`. |
| `until` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only lines before this time, same formats as `since`. |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_logs" "web" {
  container  = "web"
  tail       = "100"
  since      = "15m"
  timestamps = true
}

output "web_errors" {
  value = [for l in data.docker_logs.web.logs_list_string : l if strcontains(l, "ERROR")]
}
```
